title: Mixture Density Networks (MDNs):
prompt: **Mixture Density Networks (MDNs):** Why does a standard MSE neural network predict the blurry average of two modes when the true mapping $x \to y$ is one-to-many (e.g., inverse kinematics or multi-modal price trajectories), and how does predicting parameters of $K$ Gaussians $\sum_{k=1}^K \pi_k(x) \mathcal{N}(y \mid \mu_k(x), \sigma_k(x))$ solve this?
